entities.name: Nicholas Edward Brown
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Nicholas Edward Brown was an English plant taxonomist and authority on succulents. He was also an authority on several families of plants, including Asclepiadaceae, Aizoaceae, Labiatae and Cape plants.
